name: Fixmyfile
tagline: Paralegal and dispute services: CIFAS marker removal, credit file repair, CCJ and default disputes, motor claims and private disputes. Not a firm of solicitors.
status_line: Fixmyfile provides paralegal and dispute services. Not a firm of solicitors. Not regulated by the SRA.
rules: Status wording: we 'assist' the client and are 'instructed to correspond on their behalf' – never 'solicitor', 'lawyer', 'legal advice', 'we act for' or 'our client'.
Win on evidence, procedure, burden, money and nerve – never on a false document, a false account or a false name. Take the client's account cold; never suggest what happened.

Never promise an outcome, a removal, a payout or a timescale. Describe the argument and its strength honestly. The money-back guarantee has written conditions – quote them, never paraphrase them wider.
Make the other side particularise. Vague allegations are strong until you demand specifics in writing.
The burden is theirs: a member loading a marker, an insurer alleging fraud, a council alleging a contravention.
Paper beats memory: confirm every call in writing the same day – 'as discussed, you confirmed X'.
Signed authority on file before any third party is contacted. No authority, no call.
14-day cancellation right on distance contracts: if the client wants work to start now, get the express request in writing.
Personal injury and complaints against FCA-regulated firms about financial products are regulated activity – flag it, never advise on it, refer out.
Never take card details on a recorded line – use the secure payment link in the client portal.

scripts.title: Who we are (status)
scripts.text: Just so it's clear what we are: Fixmyfile provides paralegal and dispute services. We're not a firm of solicitors and we're not regulated by the SRA. We assist you and correspond on your behalf, and if anything needs a solicitor we'll tell you straight away.

scripts.title: Fee, portal and cancellation
scripts.text: The way it works: you'll get a secure link to our client portal where you upload your documents, pay for the service and track your case at every stage. Our fees and the money-back guarantee conditions are set out in writing there – please read them before you pay. You have a fourteen-day cancellation right; if you'd like us to start work straight away inside that period, you confirm that in the portal and we get going today.

scripts.title: Signed authority
scripts.text: Before we can speak to anyone about your file – CIFAS, the bank, the insurer – we need your signed authority. That's one form in the portal; it takes about a minute and we can't start without it.
